questions.title: The Correction Ceremony
questions.prompt: Before realizing his phone needed an update, what did Ben think Charlie was doing every time he fixed a typo?
options: Deleting the chat and making a new one
Personally typing out ‘edited to’ before the correction
Asking Siri to announce the corrected message
questions.explanation: Ben thought Charlie had invented an unusually formal way to correct himself. Jacky admitted he'd initially thought the same thing.

receipts.text: Was the Charlie edited to just me not having my phone updated that whole time???
He was the only one doing it so I thought he was unironically saying “edited to’…’” every time he had a typo 😂😂😂😂😂😂
I thought the same thing when the update first came out

questions.title: Two Tools, One Job
questions.prompt: Jacky dreamed he and Aidan were shooting rabbits. What unnecessary extra feature did their sawed-off shotgun have?
options: It was also a flamethrower
It launched a fishing net after every shot
It played a victory song through built-in speakers
questions.explanation: Aidan's response was ‘Nsx,’ immediately corrected to ‘Hax.’ The dream loadout had his approval.

receipts.text: I had a dream last night that me and Aidan were shooting rabbits with a sawed off shotgun that was also a flamethrower

questions.title: A Fully Booked Guardian
questions.prompt: Charlie looked back through his high-school Google Calendar. What had apparently filled his busy schedule?
options: Clash of Clans donation shifts and war briefings
Gym sessions and carefully timed protein shakes
Destiny updates and raid schedules
questions.explanation: The old calendar turned out to be a record of Destiny commitments. The Guardian had appointments to keep.

receipts.text: I’m looking back at what I had in my google calendar back in hs and it was just destiny updates or raid schedules 😂

questions.title: The Berry Inspector
questions.prompt: Ronan spotted a kid on the train performing a serious blueberry inspection. What was the kid doing to each berry?
options: Weighing it on a tiny pocket scale
Rotating it, examining it, then nodding or shaking his head
Holding it to his ear before sorting it into cups
questions.explanation: Jimmy suggested the inspection decided which berries went into jam or pie. Ronan concluded the kid had aura.

receipts.text: This kid on the train has a basket of blueberries and he keeps rotating it and looking at individual berries and either nodding or shaking his head lmao
Gotta see if they go in jam or pie

questions.title: Democracy Upstairs
questions.prompt: Dimitri described a bar where the top floor was locked into the US election. What had the downstairs crowd's attention instead?
options: A Montreal Canadiens game
A karaoke final that had gone into overtime
A replay of the last Canadian election
questions.explanation: Upstairs was Democrats Abroad. Downstairs had hockey and, in D's account, no interest in the election.

receipts.text: Bruh i was at a bar yesterday for the election, the top floor was democrats abroad at mcgill and everyone was locked in on the election. On the bottom floor the Montreal Canadians were playing and no one could give af about the election

questions.title: The Canopy Level

A Bass Pro Shops

At the bakery's free-sample counter

questions.title: A Brief Statement
questions.prompt: After clogging a gas-station toilet and finding a family waiting outside, what did Nico do before leaving?
options: Told the cashier he'd clogged it, then left without another word
Bought a plunger and handed it to the family
Put an out-of-order sign on a different bathroom
questions.explanation: Nico described the confession as unconscious. He delivered the information and immediately left the vicinity.

receipts.text: I clogged one of the toilets in a gas station and as I walked out a family of 4 was waiting to use it. Then unconsciously I went to the cashier and told him I clogged the toilet and left the vicinity without another word

questions.title: The Motion Carries
questions.prompt: Nathan was discussing lunch options with his grandma when his grandpa looked up with a complete order. What was it?
options: A steak and a milkshake
Pancakes and a martini
Scrambled eggs and a beer
questions.explanation: Everyone else was still discussing where to go. Grandpa had already settled the menu.

receipts.text: Bro I was talking about where we should go to lunch with my grandma and my grandpa just looked up at me and said “scrambled eggs and a beer” 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂

questions.title: Wrong Entity Loaded
questions.prompt: In Jimmy's cabin dream, Charlie had an app that could summon Slenderman based on the weather and time. What appeared when he used it?
options: The Mr. Incredible image that gets darker and darker
A giant version of the weather app's sun icon
Herobrine holding an umbrella
questions.explanation: The summoning app worked, technically. It just loaded a completely different uncanny figure.

receipts.text: I had this weirdly elaborate dream me and Charlie were just jittin around in a lakeside cabin and he had an app where you can make slenderman appear based on weather and time and he made him appear but instead of slenderman it was that image of Mr incredible where he gets darker and darker
